Name: Safe Return Scepter Double Click to Activate Warp
Author: ZeroXPatch
TagLine: Safe Return Scepter Double Click to Activate Warp.
Description:
Safe Return Scepter
 

Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.


Tired of accidentally warping to your front door while clearing weeds?
 
This mod is available for download here. For bug reports, feature requests, or community discussions, please visit our official Nexus Mods page:
https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?sortBy=endorsements
 
We've all been there. You are busy clearing debris or harvesting crops, you accidentally scroll one slot too far to your Return Scepter, click, and—poof—you are staring at a loading screen, standing at your front door, confused.

Safe Return Scepter is a simple, lightweight quality-of-life mod that fixes this by requiring a double-click to activate the Return Scepter.




Features

Double-Click Safety: Prevents the Return Scepter from activating on the first click. You must click twice within 0.5 seconds to warp.
Visual Feedback: A small notification ("Double-click to warp") appears on the first click so you know the mod is working
Controller Support: Works with Mouse & Keyboard and Controllers (Gamepads).
Zero Lag: Extremely lightweight code that only runs checks when you press the tool button.
 




Installation

Install the latest version of SMAPI.
Download this mod.
Unzip the SafeReturnScepter folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
Run the game using SMAPI.

Compatibility


Stardew Valley 1.6+: Fully compatible.
Multiplayer: Works perfectly in multiplayer. This is a client-side mod, so only you need to have it installed to benefit from it. It will not affect other players.
Safe to Uninstall: You can remove this mod at any time. It does not modify your save file or add custom items.
Configuration

Currently, the mod is set to a 0.5-second window for the double-click, which feels natural for most players. No configuration is required—just install and play!
